# codeMicro - Full LLM Summary

## Platform Description
codeMicro is the Model Context Protocol (MCP) Server Directory and Developer Platform based in Bengaluru, India. It provides a searchable directory of MCP server integrations, copy-pasteable documentation, and an interactive JSON-RPC playground.

## Server Directory
The directory includes verified MCP servers across categories:
- AI & Machine Learning
- Databases
- Developer Tools
- Communication
- Storage & Files
- Security & Auth
- Monitoring & Observability
- Productivity

Each server listing includes capabilities, verification status, repository links, and setup commands.

## Documentation
- Quick start guides for Claude Desktop, Cursor, and other clients
- TypeScript SDK examples
- Python SDK examples
- Protocol comparisons (MCP vs REST, GraphQL, gRPC)

## Pricing
- Free tier for individual developers
- Pro tier for professional developers
- Enterprise tier for organizations
